Bathrooms · Portsmouth

Bathroom fitting and wet rooms in Portsmouth

Full bathroom installs from strip-out to finish, handled by one team so you're not chasing separate trades.

From strip-out to finish

A&J take the old bathroom out and fit the new one: tiling, suites, walk-in showers and wet rooms, with the plumbing and electrical work done by qualified and certified trades in the same team.

Tiling done properly

Walls and floors are tiled precisely, including large-format, herringbone, mosaic and natural stone.

Tidy and reliable

Every job is left clean and tidy. Customers' Google reviews mention a full bathroom transformation, flood damage repaired quickly and a new sink fitted and wall tiled for a landlord.

pages.body:
Paving & landscaping · Portsmouth

Patios, paving and driveways in Portsmouth

Porcelain and stone patios, steps, block paving driveways and full garden transformations.

Patios and steps

Large-format porcelain patios, stone patios with curved steps and brick edging, raised patios with timber sleepers, and side paths in porcelain.

Driveways

Block paving driveways, including bordered designs.

The groundwork underneath

A patio only lasts if the base is right. A&J do the groundwork, concrete bases, footings, retaining walls and drainage as part of the job.

Gardens finished off

Turfing, artificial grass, fencing and gates to complete the garden. You can see recent patios and driveways in our project photos.
